title: Arith Geom

title: Cook Np
comment: Cook Np — Classic reference: Stephen Cook, The Complexity of Theorem Proving Procedures, 1971. Introduced with Levin the notion of NP-completeness and proved that SAT is NP-complete. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cook%E2%80%93Levin_theorem
alt_text: Cook Np. Classic reference: Stephen Cook, The Complexity of Theorem Proving Procedures, 1971. Introduced with Levin the notion of NP-completeness and proved that SAT is NP-complete.

title: Spectrogram
comment: Spectrogram — The spectrogram (also known as short time Fourier transform) reveals the geometry of sounds. Evolving harmonics of a bird's singing become smooth curves. Sounds are intrinsically (at least) 2-D (time-frequency). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spectrogram
alt_text: Spectrogram. The spectrogram (also known as short time Fourier transform) reveals the geometry of sounds. Evolving harmonics of a bird's singing become smooth curves. Sounds are intrinsically (at least) 2-D (time-frequency).

title: Geman Geman
comment: Geman Geman — Classic reference: Geman, S.; Geman, D. Stochastic Relaxation, Gibbs Distributions, and the Bayesian Restoration of Images, 1984. Introduces the Gibbs sampler. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gibbs_sampling
alt_text: Geman Geman. Classic reference: Geman, S.; Geman, D. Stochastic Relaxation, Gibbs Distributions, and the Bayesian Restoration of Images, 1984. Introduces the Gibbs sampler.

title: Gershgorin Disk
comment: Gershgorin Disk — Gershgorin circle theorem locates the eigenvalues of a matrix in the union of disks centered at the diagonal entries. Implies invertibility of diagonally dominant matrices. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gershgorin_circle_theorem
alt_text: Gershgorin Disk. Gershgorin circle theorem locates the eigenvalues of a matrix in the union of disks centered at the diagonal entries. Implies invertibility of diagonally dominant matrices.

title: Means Evol
comment: Means Evol — The geometric, arithmetic, and arithmetic-geometric means can be extended to complex numbers. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arithmetic%E2%80%93geometric_mean

title: Tukey Filter
comment: Tukey Filter — Classic reference: John Tukey, Exploratory data analysis, 1977. Introduced robust statistics methods and in particular median filtering. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exploratory_data_analysis
alt_text: Tukey Filter. Classic reference: John Tukey, Exploratory data analysis, 1977. Introduced robust statistics methods and in particular median filtering.

title: Dubin Paths
comment: Dubin Paths — Dubins' paths (i.e. shortest path for a car which cannot go backwards) define a distance that depends on the starting/ending direction. It is in general not continuous. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dubins_path
alt_text: Dubin Paths. Dubins' paths (i.e. shortest path for a car which cannot go backwards) define a distance that depends on the starting/ending direction. It is in general not continuous.

The Fisher-Tippett-Gnedenko theorem gives the distribution of the limit of the maximum of a large number of… https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fisher%E2%80%93Tippett%E2%80%93Gnedenko_theorem

title: Lda
comment: Lda — Linear discriminant analysis is a maximum likelihood classification method for Gaussian model with the same covariance for all the classes. It corresponds to the computation of Voronoi cells. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linear_discriminant_analysis
alt_text: Lda. Linear discriminant analysis is a maximum likelihood classification method for Gaussian model with the same covariance for all the classes. It corresponds to the computation of Voronoi cells.

title: Barron
comment: Barron — Classic reference: A. Barron, Universal Approximation Bounds for Superpositions of a Sigmoidal Function, 1993. Proves that 1 hidden layer perceptrons break the curse of dimensionality to approximate a class of smooth functions. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_approximation_theorem
alt_text: Barron. Classic reference: A. Barron, Universal Approximation Bounds for Superpositions of a Sigmoidal Function, 1993. Proves that 1 hidden layer perceptrons break the curse of dimensionality to approximate a class of smooth functions.

title: A Trou
comment: A Trou — "à trou" algorithm computes convolution with a large filter as a product of dilated filters. Useful to replace "strided" (subsampled) neural networks by translation-invariant networks. Useful to compute translation-invariant wavelet transforms. Relies on a nice commutation formula!
alt_text: A Trou. "à trou" algorithm computes convolution with a large filter as a product of dilated filters. Useful to replace "strided" (subsampled) neural networks by translation-invariant networks. Useful to compute translation-invariant wavelet transforms. Relies on a nice commutation formula!

title: Gsm
comment: Gsm — Classic reference: M. Wainwright, E. Simoncelli, Scale Mixtures of Gaussians and the Statistics of Natural Images, 1999. Popularized GSM to model heavy-tailed data distributions. https://papers.nips.cc/paper/1750-scale-mixtures-of-gaussians-and-the-statistics-of-natural-images.pdf

title: Cubic Curve
comment: Cubic Curve — Through nine points in generic position passes a single cubic curve. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_plane_curve
alt_text: Cubic Curve. Through nine points in generic position passes a single cubic curve.

title: Nadaraya Watson
comment: Nadaraya Watson — Classic reference: E. A. Nadaraya, On Estimating Regression, 1964. Nadaraya-Watson regression performs a localized barycentric average of the input values. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kernel_regression

title: 3D Heat
comment: 3D Heat — The heat equation in 3D smoothes all the level sets of a function. Generates melting surfaces! https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heat_equation

title: Stein Lemma
comment: Stein Lemma — Classic reference: C. Stein, A bound for the error in the normal approximation to the distribution of a sum of dependent random variables, 1972. title: Optimal Assignment
comment: Optimal Assignment — The assignment problem is relaxed to Optimal Transport by considering arbitrary probability distributions (a, b) on the points. The "matching" is only twice less sparse. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Optimal_matching
alt_text: Optimal Assignment. The assignment problem is relaxed to Optimal Transport by considering arbitrary probability distributions (a, b) on the points. The "matching" is only twice less sparse.
